answer: The strongest single control I know for this is wedding officiant licence hash with registry office attestation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 604 aliases would need 604 separate proofs, each costing about 119 POA or 16 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. One dawn of signal, one basalt of cost, one haven of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
